name: accept_project_transfer_request
description:
Accept a project ownership transfer into the selected team using its request code. Paid features can otherwise activate or increase billing on the receiving team; MCP explicitly opts out of those upgrades, including choices saved on the transfer request. Existing receiving-team entitlements still apply. Integration dependencies may require their own accepted policies and billing arrangements. Completion is asynchronous; inspect the project to verify ownership.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /projects/transfer-request/{code} --method PUT. Fill placeholders from inputs.

code.description: The code of the project transfer request.

newProjectName.description: The desired name for the project

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
